# Covestro Solutions

> > Covestro's sustainability and circular economy solutions platform, featuring insights on climate-neutral technologies, recycling innovations, and mass-balance approaches to reduce carbon footprint.

This site showcases Covestro's commitment to circular intelligence and sustainable material solutions. Led by experts like Sagar Srivastava and Devrajan Somnath, the platform provides educational resources on transitioning to a circular economy through advanced recycling technologies and greenhouse gas emission reduction strategies.
